models_evaluated: retrieval-augmented ChatGPT grounded in AUGS patient education materials

links.outcome: Expert-rated response quality (QAMAI) and usability (SUS) of a chatbot grounded in AUGS materials
links.effect: Median QAMAI score 28 (IQR 24-29.8); mean SUS 81.8 ± 11.2; no comparator arm in this pilot; citation consistency and clinical depth noted as needing improvement.
links.quote: A retrieval-augmented ChatGPT model trained on AUGS materials generated high-quality responses with excellent usability.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality and usability of a custom retrieval-augmented generative AI chatbot for pelvic floor education using expert ratings on patient-representative queries, but does not compare against a baseline without RAG in this pilot.
